release_notes: Build 108 simplifies Quiz History and the Autopilot Needs You workflow.
Quiz History now keeps Questions, Metadata, YouTube and Folder as the main selected-quiz actions, with Archive completed C to Z and Delete moved under a compact More menu.
The Quiz History page-level Refresh button is renamed Refresh analytics so it is clearly different from the global app Refresh button.
Autopilot replaces Manage task queue with Start next task for the normal Needs You workflow.
Needs You category buttons now go straight to the relevant human-action flow instead of opening an intermediate aligned-task list.
The Needs You window is presented as a one-task-at-a-time guided step with a compact layout and Step X of Y progress.
Related video tasks show numbered Open Studio and I saved it actions; Instagram tasks show Preview then Publish; viewer replies keep the editable reply and Send reply in the same guided window.
Secondary source-opening buttons are hidden in guided mode to reduce clutter, while Skip for now keeps unfinished tasks pending.
Packaging rescue and release-warning tasks still route directly to Performance because those actions genuinely require the YouTube packaging tools.
Build 107 SEO fixes and the completed C to Z archive workflow remain included unchanged.
